title: Preserve immutable original invoices and accurate refunds; do not invent legal fields (reviewed merchant/tax policy = external gate)
scope: Engineering half of BILL-06 delivered end-to-end; owner half (reviewed merchant/tax/invoice/refund/commercial policy + recurring-method acceptance) recorded as external gate per BILL-01 local-maximum.
laws: write-once invoice document: charge facts (id, number, currency, amount, plan, interval, periods, issued/paid, subscription/payment ids, billedTo, seller, lineItems, totals, recordKind) never change after first write; a mutation is a typed 503, never a silent overwrite

refund-not-mutating: derived status/amountRefunded never stored on the document; a refund is a separate write-once per-payment adjustment under the invoice; the account view projects refund state at read time

accurate refund bounds: integer 0 <= amountRefunded <= original amount, exact payment->invoice refs; out-of-range or mismatch refuses (never applied); repeated notifications idempotent (one adjustment per payment id)

no invented legal fields: tax figure, seller GST/registration/address and legalTaxInvoice claims are hard errors without a reviewed merchant-policy record; the policy record would be the sole authorized source
transaction order reads-then-writes (matches both the transactional double's contract and Firestore best practice)

suite.provider: fictional in-memory over real BillingService/BillingRepository + billing-memory double; zero network

preExistingDefectFixed.finding: hardcoded injected clock at = 2026-11-02T00:00Z; 7-day default expiry (2026-11-09T00:00Z) becomes strictly past vs real DB clock_timestamp on and after 2026-11-09, so every default invite threw InvitationPolicyError('expired') — 22/37 data-04 tests failed, reproduced byte-identically on a pristine dev worktree (NOT caused by this change)
preExistingDefectFixed.fix: rolling per-run base Date.now() - 1 day, preserving the suite's own at+7d > now > at invariant deterministically within a run; test-fixture only, separate commit, no product/assertion change

defectsFoundAndFixed.finding: assert.throws(() => service.sync(...)) cannot catch an async promise rejection; bad bounds tests reported 'Missing expected exception'. Fixed with assert.rejects.
initial writeOnceInvoice-per-receipt interleaved reads and writes, violating the billing-memory double's reads-before-writes contract. Restructured to read-all-then-write-all.

externalGatesNotClaimed: Reviewed seller/tax/invoice/refund/commercial policy and recurring-method acceptance for the actual merchant (owner/merchant gate — the owner half of BILL-06).
Real live-merchant money acceptance (BILL-07 held gate).
Any invoice displaying legal/tax fields — refuse until a reviewed policy record exists.
